inputs.checklistItemText: Trees proposed within 10 lateral feet of overhead electric utility pole
inputs.question: On the landscape plan (Sheet 31) and site plan (Sheet 9), are utility poles marked or visible? If yes, are there any tree symbols shown within 10 feet of these poles?

output.reasoning: The agent is performing a progressive presence check—first identifying whether utility poles are marked/visible on the sheets, then checking for tree symbols nearby. This is sheet discovery and feature presence verification, not yet a measurement of the actual lateral distance between trees and poles.
